items.question: 어제 순 방문자 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS yesterday_net_visitors
FROM agg_daily_users
WHERE summary_date = current_date - 1

items.question: 최근 7일 일별 페이지뷰 추이를 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT summary_date, SUM(page_views)::bigint AS page_views
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7 AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY summary_date
ORDER BY summary_date;

items.question: 최근 30일 동안 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT event_name, SUM(event_count) AS event_count
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 30
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY event_count DESC

items.question: 지난주 페이지뷰가 가장 많은 페이지 5개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  page_path,
  SUM(page_views) AS page_views
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY page_path
ORDER BY page_views DESC
LIMIT 5;

items.question: 지난주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT traffic_source, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY sessions DESC

items.question: 지난주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 이탈률(%)은?
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  SUM(sessions)::bigint AS sessions,
  SUM(bounced_sessions)::bigint AS bounced_sessions,
  ROUND(
    SUM(bounced_sessions) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0),
    2
  ) AS bounce_rate_pct
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY bounce_rate_pct DESC, sessions DESC

items.question: 최근 14일 기기 유형별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    device_type,
    SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

items.question: 이번 달 결제 완료 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(event_count), 0) AS this_month_payment_completions
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE event_name = 'is_payment'
  AND summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date;

items.question: 어제 성별 방문자 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT gender, SUM(users) AS gender_visitors
FROM agg_user_session_daily
WHERE summary_date = current_date - 1
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY gender;

items.question: 최근 7일 연령대별 평균 세션 시간(초)은?
items.sql:
SELECT
  age_group,
  SUM(session_duration_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) AS avg_session_duration_seconds
FROM agg_user_session_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY age_group;

items.question: 지난주 시간대(0~23시)별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  summary_hour,
  SUM(sessions) AS session_count
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY summary_hour
ORDER BY summary_hour;

items.question: 최근 7일 nov_mega_sale 캠페인의 유입 소스·매체별 세션 수와 전환 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  traffic_medium,
  SUM(sessions)::bigint AS sessions,
  SUM(conversions)::bigint AS conversions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
  AND traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium
ORDER BY sessions DESC, traffic_source, traffic_medium;

items.question: 최근 7일 페이지뷰 100회 이상인 페이지 중 평균 체류 시간(초)이 가장 긴 5개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  page_path,
  SUM(page_views) AS total_page_views,
  SUM(time_on_page_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(page_views), 0) AS avg_time_on_page_seconds
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY page_path
HAVING SUM(page_views) >= 100
ORDER BY avg_time_on_page_seconds DESC
LIMIT 5;

items.question: 15일 전 기기 유형별로 /checkout/success 페이지를 본 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  device_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= current_date - 15
  AND timestamp < current_date - 14
  AND page_path = '/checkout/success'
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH week_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('week', current_date)::date AS this_week_start,
    date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7 AS last_week_start
)
SELECT
  t.traffic_source,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.summary_date >= w.this_week_start AND t.summary_date <= current_date THEN t.sessions ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint AS this_week_sessions,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.summary_date >= w.last_week_start AND t.summary_date < w.this_week_start THEN t.sessions ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint AS last_week_sessions,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.summary_date >= w.this_week_start AND t.summary_date <= current_date THEN t.sessions ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.summary_date >= w.last_week_start AND t.summary_date < w.this_week_start THEN t.sessions ELSE 0 END), 0)::bigint AS session_diff
FROM agg_traffic_hourly t
CROSS JOIN week_bounds w
WHERE t.summary_date >= w.last_week_start
  AND t.summary_date <= current_date
GROUP BY t.traffic_source
ORDER BY this_week_sessions DESC, traffic_source;

items.question: 지난주 세션 100개 이상인 유입 소스·매체 중 전환율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  traffic_medium,
  SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions,
  SUM(conversions) AS total_conversions,
  SUM(conversions) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium
HAVING SUM(sessions) >= 100
ORDER BY conversion_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3;

items.question: 최근 28일 동안 요일별(ISO 요일 번호, 월=1) 하루 평균 세션 수는?
items.sql:
WITH daily_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        summary_date,
        SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
    FROM agg_user_session_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
      AND summary_date < current_date
    GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
    EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date)::int AS iso_weekday,
    AVG(total_sessions) AS avg_daily_sessions,
    COUNT(*) AS days_count
FROM daily_sessions
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

items.question: 최근 7일 기기 유형별 결제 전환율(%)을 알려줘. 결제(is_payment) 이벤트가 있었던 세션의 비율로 계산해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
  d.device_type,
  COALESCE(p.payment_sessions, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(d.sessions, 0) AS payment_conversion_rate_pct
FROM (
  SELECT device_type, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
  FROM agg_user_session_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY device_type
) d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT device_type, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS payment_sessions
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'is_payment'
    AND timestamp >= current_date - 7
    AND timestamp < current_date
  GROUP BY device_type
) p ON p.device_type = d.device_type
ORDER BY d.device_type;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 일평균 순 방문자 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT '최근 7일' AS 기간, count(*)::numeric / 7 AS 일평균_순방문자수
FROM agg_daily_users
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7 AND summary_date < current_date
UNION ALL
SELECT '이전 7일', count(*)::numeric / 7
FROM agg_daily_users
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14 AND summary_date < current_date - 7
ORDER BY 기간

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수 변화를 보여줘
items.sql:
WITH this_week AS (
    SELECT event_name, SUM(event_count) AS event_count
    FROM agg_event_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    GROUP BY event_name
),
last_week AS (
    SELECT event_name, SUM(event_count) AS event_count
    FROM agg_event_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
      AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    GROUP BY event_name
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(t.event_name, l.event_name) AS event_name,
    COALESCE(t.event_count, 0) AS this_week_count,
    COALESCE(l.event_count, 0) AS last_week_count,
    COALESCE(t.event_count, 0) - COALESCE(l.event_count, 0) AS change_count,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(l.event_count, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (COALESCE(t.event_count, 0) - l.event_count) * 100.0 / l.event_count
    END AS change_rate_pct
FROM this_week t
FULL OUTER JOIN last_week l ON t.event_name = l.event_name
ORDER BY change_count DESC NULLS LAST, event_name;
